firewall_enabled.description: Whether firewalld should be enabled and started at boot (systemd).

default_zone.description: The initial zone assigned to interfaces with no explicit zone binding (e.g., 'public', 'internal', 'trusted').

min_uid.description: Minimum numeric user ID allowed to manage firewalld via D-Bus (set to -1 for no lower limit).

max_uid.description: Maximum numeric user ID allowed to manage firewalld via D-Bus (set to -1 for no upper limit).

log_denied.description: Whether to log packets that are dropped or rejected. Valid values: 'off', 'unicast', 'broadcast', 'multicast'.

auto_install.description: Automatically install required kernel modules (e.g., nftables) when firewalld starts.

backend.description: Firewall backend. Use 'nftables' for modern kernels; 'iptables' for legacy (not recommended).

runtime_only.description: If true, firewalld runs in runtime-only mode (changes are not saved to persistent config).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent D-Bus connections allowed.

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable support for IPv6 networking in firewalld policies.

direct_rules_enabled.description: Enable direct rules — allows raw iptables/nftables commands via firewalld (advanced users only).

custom_config_paths.description: List of directories where custom zone/service/policy XML files are stored (added to search path before defaults).

items.description: Absolute path to a configuration directory (e.g., '/etc/firewalld/custom-zones').

runtime_config_paths.description: List of directories for runtime-only XML files (not saved persistently).

items.description: Absolute path to a runtime config directory (e.g., '/run/firewalld/runtime-configs').
